title: Refund Composition Settings for Returns & Exchanges
content:
This Returns & Exchanges settings matrix records, for each return type, what a refund is built from, whether Return Store Credit is paid before inspection, and the settings for gift returns.

## Refund content

| Return type | Original shipping fee and surcharge refunded | Sales tax on accepted units refunded | Tax basis | Rounding of prorated tax and computed fees |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | No | Yes | Order tax shared pro rata by net merchandise | Half up to the cent, per line |
| Store Credit Return | No | Yes | Order tax shared pro rata by net merchandise | Half up to the cent, per line |
| Size Exchange | No | Yes | Order tax shared pro rata by net merchandise | Half up to the cent, per line |
| Instant Exchange | No | Yes | Order tax shared pro rata by net merchandise | Half up to the cent, per line |
| Gift Return | No | Yes | Order tax shared pro rata by net merchandise | Half up to the cent, per line |
| Quality Issue Return | Yes | Yes | Order tax shared pro rata by net merchandise | Half up to the cent, per line |

## Instant credit and gift settings

| Return type | Return Store Credit issued at first carrier scan | Recovery when instant credit for rejected units is already spent | Gift return refund basis | Purchaser told of a gift return |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Store Credit Return | Yes | Charge to the original card | Not applicable | No |
| Size Exchange | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Instant Exchange | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Gift Return | No | Not applicable | Net price paid | No |
| Quality Issue Return | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |

## Notes

- Only the Quality Issue Return has the original shipping setting switched on.
- Only the Store Credit Return pays Return Store Credit at the first carrier scan, and so only that type has a recovery setting for instant credit already spent.
- The gift return refund basis is set only on the Gift Return; the purchaser of a gift order is not told of a gift return on any type.
